items.source: Invoked after argument resolvers have been called, and before the HttpRequestValues is built.
items.translation: 在调用参数解析器之后、构建 HttpRequestValues 之前被调用。

items.source: Use HttpServiceProxyFactory.Builder.httpRequestValuesProcessor(Processor) to add such a processor.
builder - the builder to add request values too; the builder also exposes method HttpRequestValues.Metadata from the HttpExchange method.
items.translation: builder - 用于添加请求值的构建器；该构建器还暴露了来自 HttpExchange 方法的 HttpRequestValues.Metadata 方法。

items.source: parameters - provides access to method parameter information
items.translation: parameters - 提供方法参数信息的访问权限

items.source: arguments - the raw argument values to the method
items.translation: arguments - 传递给方法的原始参数值
